    The Denver Nuggets play the Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 2 of the NBA Playoffs tonight (Monday, April 20, 2026) at 8:30 p.m. MST (10:30 p.m. ET) at Ball Arena in Denver. The game is televised on NBC and available to stream on Peacock. Denver leads the series 1-0 after a 116-105 win in Game 1. 
    Game 2 Details: 
    • Matchup: Minnesota Timberwolves vs. Denver Nuggets
    • Time: 8:30 p.m. MST / 10:30 p.m. ET (Monday, April 20)
    • Location: Ball Arena, Denver, CO
    • TV/Streaming: NBC, Peacock
    • Series: Nuggets lead 1-0
    • Odds: Denver is a -7.5 point favorite 
    Following tonight's game, the series moves to Minnesota for Game 3 on Thursday, April 23, at 7:30 p.m. PDT (Target Center).
